phase2b_statements: Finalisation of the Phase 2B protocol, reported as in progress in February 2026.
The planned Phase 2B study will evaluate dose response, symptoms, safety and tolerability of NWPT-SM32300 in people at clinical high risk of psychosis.
The Phase 2B study is not recruiting.
clinical_design.scope: States only population, aims and status. Doses, comparator, duration, endpoints and size are not stated because no CHR-P design source was supplied; nothing is taken from schizophrenia studies. Keep the live site's published design section.
